title: Right-unit component for the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_constraints_right_unit
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry) :
    ∀ A : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X,
      closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) data.unit.hom) ≫
          data.tensor.hom.app (A, pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X) ≫
          (ordinary l X R).map (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l (PadicAlgCl l) X A).hom =
        (closed.monoidal.rightUnitor ((ordinary l X R).obj A)).hom

proof.text: The universal assertion is still conditional on the pending, disputed left-unit and associativity declarations: this reduction does not repair arbitrary comparison data. Use their components at (U,U) and (A,U,U), respectively, where U is the prescribed common-stage tensor unit. The helper right_unit_of_left_associativity is an independently proved categorical implication with these equations as explicit hypotheses.

Use the triangle identity for the prescribed common-stage associator and unitors at (A,U). Tensor the desired equation on the right by ordinary(U), which is faithful since data.unit identifies ordinary(U) with the native tensor unit. Postcompose with the invertible tensorator at (A,U). Naturality of the tensorator and the common-stage triangle turn the left side into the left side of associativity at (A,U,U).

On the other side of associativity, slide the unit comparison through the native associator by naturality. The left-unit equation at U and the native monoidal triangle reduce it to the tensor of the native right unitor. Cancel the tensorator and use faithfulness of tensoring by ordinary(U) to obtain the required right-unit equation. No finite-representative right-unit statement, nonzero hypothesis, or normalization field is introduced.
